country_decisions: CFG-TRN-001: competent authorities and statutory responsibilities (the vehicleRegistration, roadAuthority and transportRegulator slots; none ship).
CFG-TRN-002: licence classes, eligibility criteria and required examinations (none ship).
CFG-DAT-001: retention and disclosure of the case and its personal data.

library.title: Apply for a driving licence
library.intro: Apply for a driving licence in the categories you need. Your identity and evidence are checked, the test is recorded and two officials decide. Where the law asks for a medical fitness certificate, only its sealed reference is kept on the licence.
library.filled_by: The applicant; an official at an office.
library.authority: Filed with the vehicle and driver licensing body the nation names (vehicleRegistration slot, shipped empty).

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it

The competent body is the institution the nation names for its slot of the deployment profile (landRegistry, buildingControl, housing, vehicleRegistration, roadAuthority, transportRegulator), shipped empty; who holds each power over a decision comes from the permit authority registry, proposed and unapproved
deviations.why: Authority comes from the deployment profile and the approved mappings, never a ministry by name; a production installation refuses a power no approved mapping covers.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: authorityFor(); lib/permits/decisions.ts (plan I7)

deviations.what: Vehicle registration, a driving licence, an operator licence and a road works permit are four records kept apart, each by the body the nation names
deviations.why: Catalogue Part 9 §4.3: never one undifferentiated approved status.

deviations.what: Every registration and decision is proposed by one official and confirmed by a different person; the official who verified or reviewed does not decide
deviations.why: Catalogue Part 8 §3.3 and Part 9 §5: dual control by distinct authorised individuals.

deviations.what: No step is decided by a model, a score or a map: officials decide with reasons
deviations.why: AI never makes a legally material decision.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model (AI never makes a legally material decision)

deviations.what: Categories, classes and kinds the law decides are the nation's configured lists; none ship (a proposed list is marked proposed)
deviations.why: CivicOS never invents authority or classifications.

deviations.what: Medical fitness to drive is never a field: where the law asks for it, the licence keeps only the reference of a sealed document (its id and SHA-256)

quotes: Applicant selects the service, licence category or vehicle transaction, and responsible jurisdiction.
Validate required evidence and authorized verification responses.
An inconclusive check must not automatically become a rejection.
Apply the configured requirements for the relevant licence category or registration transaction.
Record missing prerequisites and their sources.
Schedule and record any required test, inspection, technical certificate or specialist assessment.
An appropriately empowered officer or system-authorized process records the decision within the legally permitted scope.
Adverse decisions follow required human-review and reasoning safeguards.
Issue the relevant credential or registration evidence only after required approvals.
Record effective date, expiry, restrictions and delivery.
Preserve prior events and route changes through the applicable renewal, correction, suspension-review or appeal workflow.

platform.how: Each record keeps its events; renewal, correction and appeal are further cases
